Write $S_i=e^{z_i}/Z$, $Z=\sum_k e^{z_k}$. The quotient rule gives $\partial S_i/\partial z_j=S_i\delta_{ij}-S_iS_j$, or $J=\operatorname{diag}(S)-SS^T$. For $L=-\sum_i y_i\log S_i$, multiply by $-y_i/S_i$ and sum to obtain $\partial L/\partial z_j=S_j\sum_i y_i-y_j$. With normalized target probabilities this is $S_j-y_j$. [1](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/) [2](https://d2l.ai/)

The gradients sum to zero, consistent with invariance to adding the same constant to every logit. Use log-softmax/log-sum-exp for stability. Label smoothing retains the formula when its targets sum to one; arbitrary unnormalized targets do not. Include batch-reduction factors and class-weight effects explicitly rather than assuming every cross-entropy implementation has identical gradients.
